To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) offline evaluation is not sufficient to predict performance on the real world, (2) the best teams in the offline evaluation were not necessarily the top teams in the online evaluation, (3) the top 3 teams in the offline ranking were not among the top teams in terms of user engagement and (4) teams with a strong focus on user engagement were not among the best teams in terms of offline evaluation.
• The offline evaluation is a good predictor for the online performance.
